scope: Main 326–336 and Algorithm C conclusion on 337; exercises 7.2.1.2–35–54; answers 708–711 through 54

exceptions.detail: Historical memory-reference totals and comparative speedups for alphametic solvers on main 333–334 and in answer 49 were retained without rerunning those experiments. The pruning predicates, signature tables, list operations and exact symbolic step counts in 47–48 were reviewed.

Historical priority and bibliographic attributions were retained with published corrections. The large decimal table count in 35 and numerical estimate A10 in 37 were not recomputed; their product formulas and leading logarithmic asymptotic were checked. The displayed small permutation constructions and structural proofs were reviewed without exhaustive program implementations.
